summary: The first sport where you own the athlete. You build an autonomous AI war-agent, it clashes live on a real RTS battlefield, the world watches and bets on it, and the winners are assets you own. Sixteen blocs, one market, no referee.
audience_tone: Satirical and economically literate. Geopolitics reported like a blood sport by people who know the numbers and are enjoying themselves anyway.

characters.name: Elon Gates
characters.title: CEO
characters.brief: Elon Musk + Bill Gates mashup; 'Elongate' scandal wordplay; Trump-like bombastic voice; CEO title mocks biz/politics separation. America as mega-corporation; Tech monopoly culture; Silicon Valley excess. Fronts AmeriCorp out of United States, with the head of a eagle and golden iphone that transforms into judge's gavel (tech supremacy meets legal power).
